def: A graph that sums up data with five key numbers.
defEs: Una gráfica que resume los datos con cinco números clave.
alt: Illustration of Box Plot: A graph that sums up data with five key numbers.

def: The middle number when they are in order.
defEs: El número del medio cuando están en orden.
alt: Illustration of Median: The middle number when they are in order.

def: One of three numbers that split data into four equal parts.
defEs: Uno de tres números que dividen los datos en cuatro partes iguales.
alt: Illustration of Quartile: One of three numbers that split data into four equal parts.

def: The box part of a box plot. It holds half the data.
defEs: La caja de un diagrama de caja. Tiene la mitad de los datos.
alt: Illustration of Middle half: The box part of a box plot. It holds half the data.

def: The distance across the middle half of the data.
defEs: La distancia que cubre la mitad central de los datos.
alt: Illustration of Interquartile Range: The distance across the middle half of the data.

def: How far apart the numbers are.
defEs: Qué tan separados están los números.
alt: Illustration of Variability: How far apart the numbers are.
